verzen.tekst: Honour a physician according to your need with the honours due to him,
verzen.html: Honour a physician according to your need with the honours due to him,

verzen.tekst: For healing comes from the Most High,
verzen.html: For healing comes from the Most High,

verzen.tekst: The skill of the physician will lift up his head.
verzen.html: The skill of the physician will lift up his head.

verzen.tekst: The Lord created medicines out of the earth.
verzen.html: The Lord created medicines out of the earth.

verzen.tekst: Wasn’t water made sweet with wood,
verzen.html: Wasn’t water made sweet with wood,

verzen.tekst: He gave men skill
verzen.html: He gave men skill

verzen.tekst: With them he heals
verzen.html: With them he heals

verzen.tekst: With these, the pharmacist makes a mixture.
verzen.html: With these, the pharmacist makes a mixture.

verzen.tekst: My son, in your sickness don’t be negligent,
verzen.html: My son, in your sickness don’t be negligent,

verzen.tekst: Put away wrong doing, and direct your hands in righteousness.
verzen.html: Put away wrong doing, and direct your hands in righteousness.

verzen.tekst: Give a sweet savour and a memorial of fine flour,
verzen.html: Give a sweet savour and a memorial of fine flour,

verzen.tekst: Then give place to the physician, for truly the Lord has created him.
verzen.html: Then give place to the physician, for truly the Lord has created him.

verzen.tekst: There is a time when recovery is in their hands.
verzen.html: There is a time when recovery is in their hands.

verzen.tekst: For they also shall ask the Lord
verzen.html: For they also shall ask the Lord

verzen.tekst: He who sins before his Maker,
verzen.html: He who sins before his Maker,

verzen.tekst: My son, let your tears fall over the dead,
verzen.html: My son, let your tears fall over the dead,

verzen.tekst: Make bitter weeping and make passionate wailing.
verzen.html: Make bitter weeping and make passionate wailing.

verzen.tekst: For from sorrow comes death.
verzen.html: For from sorrow comes death.

verzen.tekst: In calamity, sorrow also remains.
verzen.html: In calamity, sorrow also remains.

verzen.tekst: Don’t give your heart to sorrow.
verzen.html: Don’t give your heart to sorrow.

verzen.tekst: Don’t forget it, for there is no returning again.
verzen.html: Don’t forget it, for there is no returning again.

verzen.tekst: Remember his end, for so also will yours be:
verzen.html: Remember his end, for so also will yours be:

verzen.tekst: When the dead is at rest, let his remembrance rest.
verzen.html: When the dead is at rest, let his remembrance rest.

verzen.tekst: The wisdom of the scribe comes by the opportunity of leisure.
verzen.html: The wisdom of the scribe comes by the opportunity of leisure.

verzen.tekst: How could he become wise who holds the plough,
verzen.html: How could he become wise who holds the plough,

verzen.tekst: He will set his heart upon turning his furrows.
verzen.html: He will set his heart upon turning his furrows.

verzen.tekst: So is every craftsman and master artisan
verzen.html: So is every craftsman and master artisan

verzen.tekst: So too is the smith sitting by the anvil
verzen.html: So too is the smith sitting by the anvil

verzen.tekst: So is the potter sitting at his work
verzen.html: So is the potter sitting at his work

verzen.tekst: He will fashion the clay with his arm
verzen.html: He will fashion the clay with his arm

verzen.tekst: All these put their trust in their hands.
verzen.html: All these put their trust in their hands.

verzen.tekst: Without these no city would be inhabited.
verzen.html: Without these no city would be inhabited.

verzen.tekst: They won’t be sought for in the council of the people.
verzen.html: They won’t be sought for in the council of the people.

verzen.tekst: But they will maintain the fabric of the age.
verzen.html: But they will maintain the fabric of the age.
